name: drawio-diagram-service
description: HTTP bridge between ServeAI and the draw.io rendering service: shape libraries, XML validation/repair, per-conversation working copies, and render proxying

nodemonConfig.//: Watch only source. STORAGE_ROOT may point inside the project, and nodemon watches .json by default -- without this, writing a {fileId}.json sidecar restarts the server mid-request and the caller sees ECONNRESET.
